requirements.quote:
The semantics of this extension
   are that the client only supports the use of PSKs with these modes,
   which restricts both the use of PSKs offered in this ClientHello and
   those which the server might supply via NewSessionTicket.
requirements.required_behavior: use PSKs offered in the ClientHello only with an advertised key exchange mode
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use an offered PSK with a mode absent from psk_key_exchange_modes
requirements.why_checkable: The selected PSK mode can be compared with the client's advertised mode vector.

requirements.quote:
A client MUST provide a "psk_key_exchange_modes" extension if it
   offers a "pre_shared_key" extension.
requirements.condition: when a client offers a pre_shared_key extension
requirements.why_checkable: A ClientHello can be inspected for the co-presence of both extensions.

requirements.quote:
If clients offer
   "pre_shared_key" without a "psk_key_exchange_modes" extension,
   servers MUST abort the handshake.
requirements.condition: when a ClientHello contains pre_shared_key without psk_key_exchange_modes
requirements.forbidden_behavior: continue the handshake using the malformed PSK offer
requirements.why_checkable: A malformed extension combination has a mandatory termination outcome.

requirements.quote:
Servers MUST NOT select a key
   exchange mode that is not listed by the client.
requirements.condition: when a server selects a PSK key exchange mode
requirements.required_behavior: select a mode listed by the client
requirements.forbidden_behavior: select a mode not listed by the client
requirements.why_checkable: The server-selected mode can be compared with the offered PskKeyExchangeMode values.

requirements.quote:
This extension also
   restricts the modes for use with PSK resumption.
requirements.condition: when resuming with a PSK under a ClientHello that advertises psk_key_exchange_modes
requirements.required_behavior: use a resumption mode included in the advertised modes
requirements.forbidden_behavior: resume with a mode outside the advertised modes
requirements.why_checkable: The resumption path's selected mode can be compared with the current ClientHello.

requirements.condition: when a server sends NewSessionTicket after receiving advertised PSK modes
requirements.required_behavior: send tickets compatible with the advertised modes
requirements.forbidden_behavior: send a ticket incompatible with every advertised mode
requirements.why_checkable: The ticket's permitted resumption modes can be checked against the client's advertisement.

requirements.quote: The server MUST NOT send a "psk_key_exchange_modes" extension.
requirements.condition: when a server constructs a TLS handshake message
requirements.why_checkable: Server-emitted extension lists can be inspected for the forbidden extension.

requirements.required_behavior: encode the enumerated value in one octet
requirements.why_checkable: The enum's maximum declared value is 255, which fixes its presentation-language width at one octet.

requirements.required_behavior: encode ke_modes as a vector whose encoded content length is from 1 through 255 octets
requirements.forbidden_behavior: encode an empty ke_modes vector or one longer than 255 octets
requirements.why_checkable: The vector length prefix and payload length are directly parseable.

requirements.quote:
psk_ke:  PSK-only key establishment.  In this mode, the server
      MUST NOT supply a "key_share" value.
requirements.required_behavior: perform key establishment using only the PSK
requirements.forbidden_behavior: incorporate an (EC)DHE shared secret into key establishment
requirements.why_checkable: The selected mode can be traced to the key-schedule inputs.

requirements.quote:
psk_ke:  PSK-only key establishment.  In this mode, the server
      MUST NOT supply a "key_share" value.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: have the server supply a key_share value
requirements.why_checkable: The selected mode and ServerHello key_share presence can be checked together.

requirements.quote:
psk_dhe_ke:  PSK with (EC)DHE key establishment.  In this mode, the
      client and server MUST supply "key_share" values as described in
      Section 4.2.8.
requirements.required_behavior: perform key establishment using the PSK together with an (EC)DHE shared secret
requirements.why_checkable: The selected mode can be traced to the key-schedule inputs.

requirements.quote:
psk_dhe_ke:  PSK with (EC)DHE key establishment.  In this mode, the
      client and server MUST supply "key_share" values as described in
      Section 4.2.8.
requirements.required_behavior: have the client supply a key_share value as described in Section 4.2.8
requirements.why_checkable: The ClientHello can be inspected for the required key_share under the selected mode.

requirements.quote:
psk_dhe_ke:  PSK with (EC)DHE key establishment.  In this mode, the
      client and server MUST supply "key_share" values as described in
      Section 4.2.8.
requirements.required_behavior: have the server supply a key_share value as described in Section 4.2.8
requirements.why_checkable: The ServerHello can be inspected for the required key_share under the selected mode.
